en.headline: Giant character balloons fill Causeway Bay street for free Merry Balloon preview
en.dek: Cookie Monster, Snoopy and a SpongeBob figure hang above Pak Sha Road through Sunday as a free warm-up for the December Kai Tak event.
body: Three large character balloons have been suspended above Pak Sha Road in Causeway Bay as part of a free three-day preview for Merry Balloon Hong Kong 2026. The inflatables depict Cookie Monster from Sesame Street, Snoopy and a Bikini Bottom resident from SpongeBob SquarePants.

The preview runs from 27 to 29 November. On Sunday it opens from noon to 7pm. Organisers MAKEITLOUD, with support from the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and the Hong Kong Tourism Board, said the street activation includes game booths, food and drink stalls and limited free flower-shaped balloons. A timing challenge asks participants to stop a timer at exactly 12.18 seconds for a chance at prizes.

The main Merry Balloon Park will take place at Kai Tak Sports Park from 18 to 27 December, with a parade on 27 December. General admission tickets for the park are on sale through HK Ticketing and package tickets through Klook. The organisers said the Causeway Bay preview lets residents see the scale of the installations ahead of the larger December programme.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣白沙道巨型角色氣球免費預熱Merry Balloon
zh.dek: 芝麻街Cookie Monster、Snoopy及海綿寶寶角色氣球懸掛白沙道至周日，為12月啟德活動預熱，免費入場。
body: 三個大型角色氣球懸掛在銅鑼灣白沙道上空，作為Merry Balloon Hong Kong 2026的三日免費預熱活動。氣球分別是《芝麻街》的Cookie Monster、Snoopy及《海綿寶寶》比奇堡居民。
預熱活動由11月27日至29日舉行，周日中午12時至晚上7時開放。主辦單位MAKEITLOUD在文化體育及旅遊局及香港旅遊發展局支持下舉辦，現場設有攤位遊戲、餐飲攤位及限量免費花花氣球。計時挑戰要求參加者在12.18秒準確按停計時器，有機會贏取獎品。
主要的Merry Balloon Park將於12月18日至27日在啟德體育園舉行，巡遊則在12月27日。公園一般門票經快達票發售，套票經Klook。主辦單位表示，銅鑼灣預熱讓市民先感受裝置規模，為12月較大型活動作準備。
